node.statement: Adjoint reduction for the second identity: for every star-preserving T, the first associativity estimate applied to (Z^*,Y^*,X^*) and then adjointed is exactly ||T(T(X)T(T(Y)T(Z)))-T(T(X)T(Y)T(Z))|| at most the same constant times ||X||||Y||||Z||; hence Phi_assoc2 follows from Phi_assoc1 with constant 10 at every amplification.
